label: STATIC 2012
laws: MORE MACHINE REQUIRES A NAMED BOTTLENECK

capabilities.description: Launch the local First House / Workbench doorway and preserve user-owned state.
Hash, address, inspect and verify bounded local artifacts.
Create, receive, hold and verify bounded crossing/receipt material locally.
Inspect bounded possibility lineage, checkpoints, forks and graph-frontier commitments.
Retain recent detail plus bounded resumable checkpoint/frontier memory.
Run hashes, deterministic witnesses, exact bounded checks and sparse probes.
Inspect capability cards and make explicit bounded dispatch decisions without requiring heavy execution locally.
Run deterministic editing/listening-field workflows; preview and decode cost may require degraded settings.

bottleneck.evidence: Long media decode and preview buffers can exceed the reference machine comfort envelope.

capabilities.fallback: Lower preview resolution, proxy media, section-first editing, or dispatch final render as an instrument.

capabilities.description: Compose recipes, descendants, ghosts and recombination graphs locally while deferring expensive rendering.

bottleneck.evidence: Resolved media generation/rendering can exceed the reference machine comfort envelope.

capabilities.fallback: Keep composition as recipes/proposals locally and dispatch render-only work.

capabilities.description: Inspect walkable consequence/frontier state with simplified visual settings.

bottleneck.evidence: Complex real-time visual projections may exceed integrated-graphics or memory capacity.

capabilities.fallback: Use reduced effects, lower resolution, static/2D projection, or remote rendering while local state remains authoritative.

capabilities.description: Final high-resolution render is a dispatchable instrument rather than a core local requirement.

bottleneck.evidence: Sustained high-resolution encoding/rendering is disproportionately slow on the reference hardware.

capabilities.fallback: Dispatch to another opted-in machine/service and return addressed artifacts for local verification/admission.

capabilities.description: Modern generative video is an external instrument, not a local sovereignty requirement.

bottleneck.evidence: Contemporary video models generally require accelerator memory or hosted model infrastructure absent from the reference target.

capabilities.fallback: Use an opted-in external instrument; retain request, result address and admission decision locally.

capabilities.description: Large-model inference is optional and dispatchable.

bottleneck.evidence: Large modern model weights and working memory exceed the reference target RAM/accelerator envelope.

capabilities.fallback: Use a smaller local model where sufficient, or dispatch to an opted-in model instrument.

capabilities.description: Discovery never grants permission to execute capabilities automatically.

bottleneck.evidence: The limitation is constitutional rather than computational: discovery/capability does not imply authority.

capabilities.fallback: Require explicit local selection and bounded dispatch through the owning instrument boundary.
